summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Joanna Senyszyn, a Polish academic. It states she holds the rank of Professor ordinarius and the chair in market research at the University of Gdańsk. It also notes she was Dean of the Faculty of Business Administration there before being elected to the Sejm.
one_line: Joanna Senyszyn is a professor of market research at the University of Gdańsk and former dean who was later elected to the Sejm.
key_facts: Joanna Senyszyn holds the academic rank of Professor ordinarius.
Joanna Senyszyn holds the chair in market research at the University of Gdańsk.
Joanna Senyszyn served as the Dean of the Faculty of Business Administration at the University of Gdańsk.
Joanna Senyszyn was elected to the Sejm after serving as Dean of the Faculty of Business Administration at the University of Gdańsk.
